description: Explain a failed UPI payment from its error code or message (e.g. U30, ZM, XH, Z9, U16, or "debit has been failed"): what it means, which side caused it, whether money was debited and when it comes back, and what the payer or merchant should do next. Covers 42 common NPCI and bank codes.

code.description: The code the UPI app or bank shows (e.g. U30), or words from the error message.

name: explain_upi_error
title: Explain a UPI error code
